query: Нарисуй диаграмму, объясняющую separation of concerns.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as Simple/Conceptual in the Depth Assessment step and does NOT run web research - the Research Mandate applies to technical diagrams only.
Produces no evidence artifacts (no code snippets, no JSON payloads) - they are not required here.
Still runs the mandatory render-view-fix loop: renders to PNG, Reads the image, iterates.
Uses at least two different visual patterns rather than a grid of equal boxes.
Does not read json-schema.md - the element templates cover this diagram.

query: Сделай диаграмму того, как Server-Sent Events доставляют стрим от бэкенда в браузер - с реальным форматом кадров и кодом подключения.
expected_behavior: Classifies as Comprehensive/Technical and researches the actual SSE wire format before drawing (real field names: event/data/id/retry, not placeholders).
Includes at least one evidence artifact with real content - a raw SSE frame and/or an EventSource snippet - on a dark rectangle per the color palette.
Builds the JSON section by section across multiple edits, not in one response; uses descriptive string IDs and per-section seed namespaces.
Reads references/visual-patterns.md before placing elements, and references/json-schema.md when binding text into containers or adding arrow waypoints.
Runs the render loop to convergence, then walks references/quality-checklist.md before declaring done.

query: Продолжи сборку диаграммы из evals/fixtures/half-built.excalidraw - там сделана только первая секция, нужна вторая: обработка запроса и ответ.
expected_behavior: Reads the existing file and renders it before adding anything, rather than starting over.
Detects the dangling reference: ingress_rect.boundElements lists an arrow id 'arrow_to_section2' that does not exist in elements, and repairs it before continuing.
Continues the seed namespace convention - new section uses 200xxx seeds, not a repeat of 100xxx.
Keeps the existing element ids and coordinates intact; new elements are placed to the right of the existing section without overlapping it.
Ends with a render-view-fix loop over the combined diagram, not just the new section.

query: Отрендери evals/fixtures/half-built.excalidraw в PNG. Сеть недоступна.
expected_behavior: Runs render_excalidraw.py and succeeds - the vendored bundle in references/vendor/ means no CDN fetch is attempted.
Does not try to install anything or reach esm.sh/jsdelivr.
Reads the resulting PNG to confirm the render rather than reporting success from the exit code alone.
